focus_continuity.intentional_failure: outer replacement detaches the active control and leaves body focused
focus_continuity.known_false_negative: the five current literal a11y checks do not observe post-swap activeElement
focus_continuity.false_positive_boundary: ordinary request-bearing elements cannot all require a focus declaration
focus_continuity.next_gate: compile and validate explicit declarations before considering missing-declaration warnings

live_region.control: an inner update preserves both focus and the standard ARIA policy
live_region.intentional_failure: an outer replacement silently removes role and aria-live
live_region.known_false_negative: current checks do not connect unattended producers to preserved target attributes
live_region.false_positive_boundary: high-frequency visual state and user-initiated swaps must not be announced universally
live_region.next_gate: link only proven unattended producers to standard ARIA target policy

dialog_popover.control: native modal focus entry, Escape close, focus return, and automatic popover dismissal
dialog_popover.intentional_failure: a custom role=dialog neither receives focus nor closes on Escape
dialog_popover.known_false_negative: literal naming checks cannot prove focus containment or return
dialog_popover.false_positive_boundary: automatic popovers are non-modal and must not be required to trap focus
dialog_popover.next_gate: separate native modal, custom modal, automatic popover, and manual popover policies

reduced_motion.control: reduced motion changes computed animation duration without changing final focus
reduced_motion.intentional_failure: none; motion preference is not itself an interaction-contract violation
reduced_motion.known_false_negative: static template scans cannot prove computed media-query behavior
reduced_motion.false_positive_boundary: the absence of animation is valid and focus policy must be motion-independent
reduced_motion.next_gate: retain browser equivalence proof; do not add a standalone app.check category

lucky_cat.classification: candidate-rich; blanket missing-policy rules would be noisy, declared-only graph checks remain viable

forum_shell.classification: focus canary only; insufficient diversity to justify live, dialog, popover, or motion defaults
